Recorded claim:
The RNP 0.17.1 vendor recipe changes include/exclude paths for libsexpp, removes two patches no longer needed upstream, and runs rnp_symbols.py against the vendored public header to refresh rnp.symbols after an update. The companion build patch lists the renamed and new files. Bugzilla described preparing the config, running mach vendor, then applying the build patch as one update. This is an integration checklist supported by this RNP stack, not a broad style rule. D204665 was accepted without inline change requests.
